measured_values_reason: Null by seed/contract.yaml's own convention: every quantity recorded null is measured at Phase 1 build time on the grading host and never authored at Phase 0. Authoring a floor, knee or ablation worth here would invent a measurement the bytes have not earned. The per-utterance latency bound in corpus_layout is deliberately not one of these: it is a published specification the instruction states and the controls are written against, not a distribution measured on this slot, and CTL-OVERBUDGET cannot target a model that exceeds a bound that does not yet exist.
